req.title: Return 405 for unsupported /players root method
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 405 when using DELETE on /players/ (collection).

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should return a 405 HTTP status code when a DELETE request is made to the /players/ endpoint, which is not supported. This behavior ensures that only allowed HTTP methods are used on specific endpoints, maintaining the integrity and expected behavior of the API. The test suite includes a positive test to confirm the correct response for unsupported methods, a negative test to ensure no false positives, and a boundary test to check the behavior at the edge of valid input.

tests.name: Test DELETE on /players/ returns 405
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running and accessible.
The /players/ endpoint is defined but does not support DELETE.
actions: Send a DELETE request to the /players/ endpoint.
expected: The response status code should be 405.
trace: Requirement R-PLAYER-036: The system shall respond with HTTP 405 when using DELETE on /players/ (collection).
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)
response = client.delete('/players/')
assert response.status_code == 405
